notes.text: Signatures can be formatted as HTML for individual identities
Reply prompts users to choose Reply or Reply All when both are applicable
Selected compose text was invisible in light theme due to white highlighting
Status bar icons became unreadable when selecting messages in light theme
Recipient expander would not collapse after editing message subject or body
Thunderbird could crash when adding an attachment to a message using the camera
Save All incorrectly saved each attachment using the content of the last file
Editing queued mail as new used the default identity instead of the original one
QR code scanner failed to open when no accounts were configured
Unsupported QR codes did not display feedback after scanning
With a hardware keyboard the focus could not leave To, Cc or Bcc
Long account names are resized to fit within two lines in the account drawer
